finding_summary: Completion-summary ZIP filenames include _Package while frozen archive locators omit it; hashes still identify the intended bytes.
The contract requires represented principal on all calls although the approved Identity requirement makes representation conditional.
Textually identical Identity-to-Relationships contract bodies carry different package lifecycle status strings.
ADR-REL-003 ADR-REL-004 and ADR-REL-006 titles drift across candidate and later stages while stage-local ID/title parity remains exact.
Formal Relationships ADR wording gives Identity ownership of representation truth without limiting it to attributed session context or preserving source-basis authority ownership.
Accountable-human ownership is classified for general production although first-user flows already use scheduled system actors.
REL-GP-006 names different scenarios across frozen stages and the CMT-07 Identity denominator does not map one-to-one to the five packaged Identity golden paths.
